# `TOKEN_MODE_UNTOKENIZED_DIFF`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Tokens (`TOKEN_`)](README.md#domain-token) |
| Reported by | `mapper` |

## What happened

A property changes between themes (or viewports) without a token, so modes can't express it.

## What to do

Move the listed value into a token, or set `tokens.themeFallback: "variant-axis"`.
